parameters.query:
SELECT l.id, l.name, l.phone, l.status, l.score,
       l.last_contact, l.created_at,
       c.phone_number_id, c.wa_access_token, c.name as brand_name,
       EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - l.created_at) as days_since_created,
       EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - COALESCE(l.last_contact, l.created_at)) as days_since_contact
FROM leads l
JOIN clients c ON l.client_id = c.id
WHERE l.status IN ('new', 'warm')
  AND c.wa_access_token IS NOT NULL
  AND c.phone_number_id IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - COALESCE(l.last_contact, l.created_at)) >= 2
ORDER BY l.score DESC
LIMIT 50
